title: Utility completeness: time_equ/lmt↔lat, name lookups, delta_t_userdef, centisecond formatters
description:
### Summary
Port the remaining small public utility functions found missing in the swisseph-rs/15 gap sweep: `swe_time_equ`/`swe_lmt_to_lat`/`swe_lat_to_lmt`, the name lookups (`swe_get_planet_name`, `swe_house_name`, `swe_get_ayanamsa_name`), the user-defined deltaT override, and the centisecond string formatters. All small, all spec'd in docs/c-ref-utilities.md.

### Files
- `src/context.rs` — `Ephemeris::time_equ`, `lmt_to_lat`, `lat_to_lmt`, `get_planet_name`
- `src/types.rs` — `HouseSystem::name() -> &'static str`, `SiderealMode::name() -> Option<&'static str>` (None for User mode — C returns NULL, §5)
- `src/config.rs` + `src/deltat/mod.rs` — `delta_t_userdef: Option<f64>` config field + short-circuit in the calc_deltat dispatcher (insertion point ~line 372 per the ref doc)
- `src/format.rs` (new) — `cs2timestr`, `cs2lonlatstr`, `cs2degstr`, `csroundsec` (csnorm/difcsn/d2l already live in math.rs — leave them; format.rs holds only the string producers)
- `src/lib.rs` — `pub mod format;` + re-exports
- `tests/golden/utilities.rs`, `tests/golden-data/utilities.json`, `tests/c-gen/gen_utilities.c` (new)

### Implementation steps
1. Read docs/c-ref-utilities.md in full. Then per function:
2. **time_equ** (§1): the swe_calc call it makes (body/flags per the doc), sidereal-time usage, formula and sign convention, exactly as §1 specifies. `Ephemeris::time_equ(&self, jd_ut: f64) -> Result<f64>` (days).
3. **lmt_to_lat / lat_to_lmt** (§2): thin wrappers over time_equ with the geolon term — follow §2's formula and iteration (if any) exactly.
4. **get_planet_name** (§3): dispatcher over Body: fixed names table (verbatim strings from §3), fictitious via the seorbel.txt-aware name path (§3a — note the ref doc's finding: when seorbel.txt is present it wins over the built-in name table for ALL fictitious bodies, not just 55–58; coordinate with the swisseph-rs/122 catalog if it landed, else read names via a minimal parse), asteroids via the already-ported `sweph_file::parse::extract_asteroid_name` + the seasnam.txt fallback-override logic per §3b. Signature `Ephemeris::get_planet_name(&self, body: Body) -> Result<String>` (needs &self for file access).
5. **house_name** (§4) and **ayanamsa_name** (§5): static tables verbatim from the doc, methods on the existing enums.
6. **delta_t_userdef** (§6): config field, honored via one short-circuit at the top of the deltat dispatcher; document the interaction with tidal_acceleration per §6 (which paths bypass the override, if any — follow the doc's choke-point analysis).
7. **Centisecond formatters** (§7): exact output formats — cs2timestr/cs2lonlatstr round with the `+50` bias, cs2degstr TRUNCATES (no bias), csroundsec has the zodiac-cusp round-down guard. Return `String`; match C byte-for-byte including padding/separator chars.

### C reference
docs/c-ref-utilities.md §1–§7 + Porting notes. Do not read the C source; ambiguity = escape hatch.

### Golden tests
- `gen_utilities.c` (normal libswe.a link): time_equ at 12 epochs spanning 1600–2100; lmt_to_lat/lat_to_lmt at 6 (jd, geolon) pairs incl. negative longitudes; swe_get_planet_name for ipl 0–23, 40–58, and asteroids {SE_AST_OFFSET+433, +5, +7066} with ephe path set; swe_house_name for all 25 system chars; swe_get_ayanamsa_name for sidm 0–46 (record NULL as JSON null); swe_cs2timestr/cs2lonlatstr/cs2degstr/csroundsec over a battery of centisecond values hitting the rounding-bias, truncation, and cusp-guard edges (§7 lists them — encode each documented edge case).
- `utilities.rs`: times eps 1e-9 day (time_equ is calc-derived; if it matches exactly, tighten to assert_f64_exact and note it), strings compared exactly (==), ayanamsa None ↔ null.
- Run: `cargo test --test golden utilities -- --nocapture`

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden utilities -- --nocapture` passes; all string comparisons exact
- Unit test: config with delta_t_userdef set returns exactly that value from the deltat dispatcher; unset behaves as before (existing deltat golden tests stay green)
- Full `cargo test` green; `cargo clippy` clean
- docs/codebase-map.md updated (format.rs entry, new methods, test entry)

### Escape hatch
If golden tests fail after two debugging attempts (numeric > 1e-8 or any string mismatch), STOP and report failing cases + actual/expected + attempts; escalate to Opus. String formatters are the likely tripwire (rounding bias vs truncation per function — the doc is explicit; trust it over intuition).
execution_record: Implemented all 7 sections in order. Key divergence from plan: the C ref doc's claim that SEFLG_EQUATORIAL is vestigial in swe_time_equ was wrong — the equation-of-time formula needs the Sun's Right Ascension (from EQUATORIAL), not its ecliptic longitude. Discovered on first golden test run when E was off by ~3.6 minutes. Also: C's cs2timestr/cs2degstr produce garbage for negative centisecond inputs (undefined behavior via char arithmetic on negative remainders) — excluded negative values from the golden battery since no real caller passes them. Asteroid name lookup simplified from the plan's file-cache-search approach to just calling open_asteroid_file directly each time (simpler, matches C's behavior).

Codex review: approve with notes. 4 findings fixed in c65e860:
1. [high] Comet/PlanetMoon names used offset-stripped IDs instead of raw C IDs → fixed with body.to_raw_id()
2. [medium] Chiron/Pholus MPC alias missing → added in get_planet_name only (not in normalize_asteroid_aliases — that changes the calc pipeline routing and breaks the asteroid golden test for body 12060)
3. [medium] seasnam.txt parser: ? abort + no bracket stripping → fixed
4. [medium] Centisecond formatters could overflow on extreme i32 → i64 arithmetic
